extraction.document_summary: AIA Prime Assured is a personal accident insurance plan providing worldwide accident protection (“anywhere in the world”). It pays benefits following an injury due to an accident, including (1) Compassionate Accidental Death (Plan 1/2/3 all S$5,000), (2) Broken Bones and Burns (S$10,000 / S$15,000 / S$30,000, paid using a schedule of percentages of the plan’s coverage amount), (3) Permanent Disability (S$20,000 / S$30,000 / S$50,000, using a disability schedule with stated percentage limits), (4) Daily Hospital Income (up to 365 days at S$50 / S$100 / S$150 per day), and (5) Accident Medical Reimbursement (up to 25% of the coverage amount per accident). Key limitation: most benefits’ coverage amount reduces by 50% from the policy anniversary following age 81, and Alzheimer’s/Parkinson’s pays only once during the policy life (regardless of renewal).
quality_notes: Plan 1/2/3 benefit amounts and premium amounts are clearly tabulated.
Broken Bones and Burns and Permanent Disability are given as percentage schedules of the coverage amount, with explicit aggregation caps.
No explicit general exclusions list is provided in this brochure (only a note that exclusions exist in the policy contract).

policies.quick_summary: Worldwide personal accident plan paying scheduled benefits for death, broken bones/burns, permanent disability, loss of ADLs, selected medical/hospital-related expenses, and Alzheimer’s/Parkinson’s disease (once per policy life). Most benefits are based on a coverage amount that reduces by 50% from the policy anniversary after age 81; Plan 1/2/3 set different coverage amounts and daily/per-accident benefit levels. Premiums are quoted as inclusive of 9% GST on annual/twice-yearly/monthly payment frequencies. Broken bones/burns and permanent disability payouts follow percentage schedules with explicit caps for multiple injuries/disabled events.
important_caveats: The coverage amount for all benefits will be reduced by 50% from the policy anniversary following your 81st birthday.
Alzheimer’s or Parkinson’s Disease Benefit is payable only once during the life of the policy, regardless of any renewal of this policy.
Permanent Disability Benefit will not be payable if any amount is payable under the Double Permanent Disability on Public Conveyance Benefit due to an accident.
Broken Bones and Burns and Permanent Disability payments are subject to explicit caps for multiple injuries arising from the same accident and for policy-year aggregates.
Daily Accident Hospital Income Benefit pays up to 365 days.
